Instead, it was an Earth-orbit mission where McDivitt and Schweickart tested the Lunar Module independently of the Command Module, performing maneuvers required for a Moon mission. The first Lunar Module to reach the Moon's surface was on Apollo 11, piloted by Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin.
records.pipeline_answer: Apollo 9's crew did not fly the Lunar Module to the Moon's surface. Apollo 9 was an Earth-orbit mission designed to test the Lunar Module and other systems. The first actual landing of the Lunar Module on the Moon was during Apollo 11 in July 1969, when Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed the "Eagle" in the Sea of Tranquility.
